calls.reason: The Dutch statement confirms the call and its matching oversight proposals, but its list and Al Jazeera show 20 countries plus the EU. The substance holds up while the country count does not.

The NAO strongly supports preventability through patching and firewall management, but Marcus frames this as what could have happened. Under the rule for hedged claims, that counterfactual remains uncalled.
Meduza reports election deepfakes, and Biometric Update reports mass credential theft. These support the stated risks, but five weeks cannot settle the broader near-term forecast or its exclusions.

The official Dutch text proposes exploring an international institution without specifying funding, governance arrangements or an implementation plan. That directly supports the unresolved questions Marcus identifies.
The Register documents infrastructure attacks before the statement; ChannelNews only infers AI use in later attacks. Neither settles this open-ended expectation about subsequent attempts.
